text_to_image_prompt: Create the requested production spatial reference for an existing fictional Rian Thalys story location. Image 1 locks the connected spatial geometry; later images lock the existing visual appearance. Palace suite. From reference viewpoint round raised pool on LEFT beside sea-view arched windows, canopy bed on RIGHT with navy upholstered foot bench, freestanding three-panel blue folding screen between pool and bed, rear doorway and dressing alcove beyond screen. Maintain physical dry walking route around screen, one pool and one bed only. Asset type: FOUR-VIEW ENVIRONMENT CONTACT SHEET, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, filling one portrait 9:16 canvas with narrow pale gutters. Four DIFFERENT actual camera views of ONE fixed location, not four new layouts: entry establishing view; reverse view from opposite end; left diagonal view; right diagonal view. Keep lighting/time, materials, number/positions of fixed anchors and adjacent openings consistent with the 3D reference. High-end detailed fantasy game rendering as original. All views at plausible camera height, not isometric. NO people. No text, no titles. Preserve exact existing anchors and materials. Unseen surfaces minimally completed, no new story props. Clear legible professional reference; no watermark.
